invariants.rationale: List parameters to methods are often expected to be non-null at entry to avoid NullPointerException in stream processing.
If the input list is non-empty, the first element should not be null to avoid downstream issues during record access.
Records in inputRecords are expected to be valid; nulls may indicate errors. This holds at entry for robust processing.
List.size() is always non-negative as per Java API contract.
Alternative idiom to ensure there are no null entries in inputRecords.
